notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «منصور»; «أبي وائل» and «عبد الله» are written once after the branches and belong to both
«- واللفظ لزهير -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
Ishaq's verb «قال إسحاق أخبرنا» is a wording change; his route runs to the same Jarir (the text writes «وقال الآخران، حدثنا» for the other two)
